generalHealth.title: Ubuzima muri rusange
generalHealth.subtitle: Amakuru yose y’ubuzima bwawe ahantu hamwe
generalHealth.privacyText: Akoreshwa kugira ngo AWA ikurikirane ibyawe uko biri, kandi ushobora kuyahindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
generalHealth.chronicConditionsHelper: Kanda kugira ngo wongeremo cyangwa uhindure
generalHealth.infoCardText: Ushobora guhindura aya makuru yose igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
generalHealth.errors.invalidPositiveValu: Andika agaciro gakwiye kari hejuru ya zeru.
generalHealth.errors.invalidHeight: Andika uburebure buri hagati ya 80 na 250 cm.
generalHealth.errors.invalidWeight: Andika ibiro biri hagati ya 20 na 400 kg.
generalHealth.bloodTypeSheetSubtitle: Hitamo ubwoko bw’amaraso yawe niba ubuzi.
generalHealth.conditionsSheetSubtitle: Hitamo indwara uzi ko urwaye. Ushobora guhitamo nyinshi.
generalHealth.allergiesSheetSubtitle: Hitamo allergie uzi ko ufite. Ushobora guhitamo nyinshi.
generalHealth.goalSheetSubtitle: Hitamo intego ihuye cyane n’ibyo ukurikirana ubu.
prayerTimes.title: Ibihe by’amasengesho
prayerTimes.missedPrayersNote: Amasengesho yabuze mu gihe cy’imihango ntagomba kwiturwa.
prayerTimes.guidanceSubtitle: Menya ibyibutsa n’ibiri mu nyandiko bigufasha mu migenzo yawe ya buri munsi.
prayerTimes.adjustmentHelper: Reka kuri "Nta na kimwe" niba itariki yerekanwa ihuye n’iyo ikurikizwa mu karere kawe.
prayerTimes.aboutHijriParagraph1: Amatariki ya Hijri arabarwa kandi ashobora gutandukana umunsi umwe bitewe no kubona ukwezi n’itangazo rya leta y’aho uri.
prayerTimes.aboutHijriParagraph2: Igihugu cyerekanwa gihuye n’aho ukoresha mu kubara ibihe by’amasengesho. Ntibivuze ko AWA ikura yonyine amatangazo ya leta y’icyo gihugu.
prayerTimes.schedule.title: Gahunda y’uyu munsi
prayerTimes.schedule.footnote: Amasaha abarwa hakurikijwe aho uherereye. Ibuka kuyagenzura kenshi.
prayerTimes.purity.title: Imimerere y’isuku
prayerTimes.purity.menstruatingHint: Ibimenyetso by’isuku yawe bizavugururwa umaze kwandika iherezo ry’imihango.
prayerTimes.purity.dueSubtitle: Isuku yawe yagarutse mu gihe cya {{prayerName}}. Iri sengesho rigomba gusengwa.
prayerTimes.purity.betweenTitle: Nta sengesho ryari ririmo gukorwa isuku igarutse.
hijriCalendar.title: Kalendari ya Hijri
hijriCalendar.ramadanText: Uku ni ukwezi kwo gufunga. Hano uhabona ibimenyetso by’umwuka n’ikurikirana ry’amasiganya yawe.
hijriCalendar.dhoulHijjaText: Ukwezi k’ingenzi muri kalendari ya Hijri.
hijriCalendar.noSpecialReference: Nta kimenyetso cyihariye kuri uku kwezi.
qadaa.title: Amasiganya yo kwiturwa
qadaa.allHamdulillahSubtitle: Al-hamdulillah, amasiganya yawe yo kwiturwa yose wayiturye.
qadaa.reminderTextActive: Ufite iminsi yo gufunga ukigomba kwiturwa. Tegura ikurikirana ryawe uko ubishoboye.
qadaa.reminderTextIdle: Iminsi mishya nihaba ikwiye kwiturwa, tuzakubwira nyuma ya Ramadhan.
qadaa.aboutText: Iminsi yo gufunga yabuze bitewe n’imihango mu gihe cya Ramadhan igomba kwiturwa nyuma. Allah ni we uzi neza.
qadaa.completionSubtitle: Andika umunsi witurye kugira ngo uvugurure ikurikirana ryawe.
qadaa.markCompletedAccessibility: Shyira ikimenyetso ko umunsi wo gufunga witurwe
qadaa.allCompletedText: Ikurikirana ryawe ubu riri ku gihe.
qadaa.heroAccessibilityLoading: Ikurikirana ry’amasiganya yo kwiturwa riri gutegurwa
qadaa.heroAccessibilityZero: Uri ku gihe, nta munsi wo gufunga ugomba kwiturwa ubu
qadaa.undoCompletionMessage_one: {{title}}: umunsi {{count}} witurwe uzasubizwa mu isigaranye ryawe.
qadaa.undoCompletionMessage_other: {{title}}: iminsi {{count}} yiturwe izasubizwa mu isigaranye ryawe.
qadaa.helpParagraph1: Iki gice kigufasha gukurikirana iminsi yo gufunga wabuze bitewe n’imihango mu gihe cya Ramadhan.
qadaa.helpParagraph2: Iminsi imenyekanye yonyine ituruka ku ikurikirana ry’imihango yawe mu gihe cya Ramadhan. Ushobora no kongeraho iminsi wowe ubwawe, ndetse n’iya kera. Iyo witurye umunsi, wandike ko urangiye kugira ngo umubare w’iminsi isigaye ukomeze kuba nyawo.
qadaa.ledger.surplusNote_one: Umunsi {{count}} witurwe urenze igiteranyo cy’ubu. Uguma mu nyandiko: ushobora kuwukura mu mateka.
qadaa.ledger.surplusNote_other: Iminsi {{count}} yiturwe irenze igiteranyo cy’ubu. Iguma mu nyandiko: ushobora kuyikura mu mateka.
qadaa.ledger.automaticHint: Yamenyekanye mu ikurikirana ry’imihango yawe (ntihindurirwa hano)
qadaa.form.description: Ongeraho iminsi yo gufunga uzi ko ugomba kwiturwa, nubwo yaba ari iy’imyaka myinshi ishize. Ushobora kuyihindura cyangwa kuyisiba igihe cyose.
qadaa.form.unknownYearSubtitle: Iyi minsi iri mu isigaranye ryanjye rya kera.
qadaa.form.notePlaceholder: Urugero: iminsi nari ngifite yo kwiturwa
qadaa.form.yearRequiredError: Hitamo umwaka wa Ramadhan, cyangwa uhitemo "Oya, simbyibuka".
qadaa.deleteModal.title: Gusiba iyi minsi?
qadaa.deleteModal.body_one: Ugiye gusiba {{quantityLabel}} yongeweho n’intoki. Ibi bizakura iyi minsi mu isigaranye ryawe ry’amasiganya yo kwiturwa.
qadaa.deleteModal.body_other: Ugiye gusiba {{quantityLabel}} yongeweho n’intoki. Ibi bizakura iyi minsi mu isigaranye ryawe ry’amasiganya yo kwiturwa.
qadaa.deleteModal.reassurance: Ibi bizasiba gusa iyi nyandiko yongeweho n’intoki. Iminsi yamenyekanye yonyine n’iyo wamaze kwiturwa ntizahinduka.
qadaa.errors.yearFormat: Andika umwaka w’imibare 4 (urugero: 1445 cyangwa 2018), cyangwa uhitemo "Umwaka utazwi".
qadaa.errors.yearInvalid: Uyu mwaka ntiwumvikana. Koresha umwaka wa Hijri (urugero: 1445) cyangwa wa Gregorien (urugero: 2018).
